translations.web: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
translations.bsb: When the righteous thrive, the city rejoices, and when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
translations.kjv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
translations.asv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth; And when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
